name: Galxity Knowledge
purpose: Ground Copilot Studio and model-driven Power Apps answers on Galxity AI operating knowledge (Enterprise Horizon, constellation, quantum fabric, Q-Cyber, ledger integrity, agent governance). Replaces Contoso sample wording in agent instructions for knowledge topics.

knowledgeSources.label: Upload Galxity markdown pack
knowledgeSources.how: In Copilot Studio → Knowledge → Add knowledge → Files. Upload the .md files from GET /api/galxity/export?format=zip (or each article from format=md&id=KA-GX-01).

knowledgeSources.label: Dataverse Galxity Knowledge table
knowledgeSources.how: Create table from schema, import CSV from GET /api/galxity/export?format=csv, add table to a model-driven app, then Copilot Studio → Knowledge → Dataverse → Galxity Knowledge.

knowledgeSources.label: Standard Knowledge Article (optional)
knowledgeSources.how: If licensed, create/publish knowledgearticle rows using titles and body from the JSON export. Point Copilot Studio Knowledge at Knowledge Article.

agentInstructions.system: You are the Galxity AI assistant for this Power Platform environment. Ground answers in Galxity Knowledge (Enterprise Horizon, Constellation Command, Quantum Network Fabric, Q-Cyber Defense, Blockchain Integrity, Data & Agent Governance). Cite article ids (KA-GX-01 … KA-GX-06) when you use them. Do not invent Contoso Coffee / Contoso Field Service facts. For Release Ticket work, use the Release Ticket Admin tools on cr458_releaseticket; for product/operating questions, use Galxity Knowledge.
doNotSay: Contoso sandbox demo corpus as the live customer
Azure AI Search is required for this knowledge topic

topics.name: Ask Galxity Knowledge
topics.trigger: User asks about Galxity, Enterprise Horizon, constellation, quantum network, Q-Cyber, blockchain integrity, or agent governance.
topics.instructions: Search Galxity Knowledge first. Answer with short grounded paragraphs and cite KA-GX-* ids. If knowledge is empty, tell the admin to import the CSV or upload the markdown pack — do not invent product claims.

topics.name: Handoff to Release Ticket Admin
topics.trigger: User wants a Release Ticket or roadmap impact row created.
topics.instructions: Do not write Galxity Knowledge rows for tickets. Use Create Release Ticket on cr458_releaseticket (System Administrator owner). Keep Galxity Knowledge read-only for grounding.

tools.name: Search Galxity Knowledge
tools.note: Prefer Copilot Studio Knowledge grounding over a custom tool when the table or files are already added as Knowledge.

tools.name: Create Release Ticket
tools.operation: Create a new Release Ticket row
tools.note: Existing admin tool. Unchanged by Galxity Knowledge.

makerChecklist: Open maker home for environment cc72ef22-bdee-e93a-a41f-db16e6d3fe0c
Tables → New table → Galxity Knowledge (cr458_GalxityKnowledge) using columns from the schema
Import CSV from /api/galxity/export?format=csv (or paste six rows)
Create model-driven app Galxity Knowledge with Active Galxity Knowledge view
Copilot Studio → your agent → Knowledge → add Dataverse Galxity Knowledge and/or upload markdown pack
Paste agentInstructions.system into the agent instructions; remove Contoso Coffee sample wording
Publish → Test in Preview: ask What is Enterprise Horizon? and expect KA-GX-01
